name: 張世豪
objective:
This course will introduce Google Cloud Computing related technologies and provide students with a comprehensive understanding of Google Cloud platform, architecture, services, and programming through the application of machine learning and IoT in railway systems. The course content includes: 1. Google cloud system architecture, storage network and virtualization technology, 2. Google cloud storage technology, 3. Google cloud scheduling technology, performance and security, 4. Google virtualized data center construction, 5. Google cloud services and enterprise applications, 6. Introduction to IoT technology 7. IoT standards and applications 8. Introduction to Industrial IoT network 9. IoT security and privacy protection 10. IoT internship courses and special projects. Therefore, before the midterm exam, we will mainly introduce the Google cloud system architecture. After the midterm exam, we will start to introduce the Internet of Things and its development trends. In the 11th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security issues and trends. In the 12th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology. In the 13th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 14th week. In the 15th week, we will make a special topic at the end of the 16th week. In the 17th week, we will introduce the Internet of Things information security detection technology and practice. In the 18th week, we will make a special topic report at the end.

本課程將導入  Google 雲端運算相關技術，並透過鐵道系統應用機器學習與物聯網應用實例讓學生對 Google 雲端平台、架構、服務、程式設計有全面性瞭解。課程內容包括： 1. Google 雲端系統架構、儲存網路與虛擬化技術， 2. Google 雲端儲存技術，3.Google 雲端排程技術、效能與安全，4.Google 虛擬化資料中心建置，5.Google 雲端服務與企業應用，6. 物聯網技術簡介 7. 物聯網標準與應用 8. 物聯網網介紹 9. 物聯網安全與隱私保護 10 . 物聯網與機器學習概念。11. 物聯網資訊安全問題與趨勢，第 12 週物聯網資訊安全檢測技術，13 物聯網攻擊面 ，14 物聯網安全實務保護策略 ，15 期末專題製作，16 期末專題製作 ，17 期末專題報告， 18  期末專題報告
